body: Codex data layout: conversations at <home>/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl, first line session_meta with payload.id and payload.cwd (keyed by id, not folder). Index state in state_5.sqlite (threads), thread_history_1.sqlite (turn projections), titles (thread_name) in session_index.jsonl. Not done yet: show Codex titles in `agx resume` from session_index.jsonl (they show as '(untitled)'). Codex HistoryChecker builds an in-memory cwd index per process. Resume = `codex resume <args> <id>`.
